name: ^runtime\.(query|mutate)$
reason: Convex validates and executes named backend operations; the twin checks the operation and all arguments before using the recorded response.

name: ^getHarnessPublicUrl$
reason: Environment configuration supplies the public origin; the twin computes the run URL from that origin and the input identifier.

name: ^new ConvexHttpClient$
reason: The Convex SDK constructor supplies the client instance; configuration and subsequent authentication arguments are checked by the twin.

name: ^\(client as unknown as \{ setAdminAuth\(key: string\): void \}\)\.setAdminAuth$
reason: The Convex SDK accepts the deployment credential; the twin verifies the input credential passed to this method.

name: ^Date\.now$
reason: The system clock supplies the current time; expiry arithmetic is computed by the twin.

name: ^resumeConversation$
reason: The injected continuation callback owns admission; the twin validates the row passed in and computes handback handling from its answer.

name: ^run\.pendingWork$
reason: The caller supplies current pending work; the twin computes its priority after approvals and questions.

name: ^context\?\.yieldSlot$
reason: The injected scheduling callback controls the worker slot; the twin checks the lease passed to it before reloading the turn.

name: ConvexHttpClient
reason: The SDK owns transport and authentication state; twins check constructor and method arguments and use instance identity only.

name: ^crypto\.subtle\.digest$
reason: Web Crypto computes SHA-256; the twin checks the UTF-8 input bytes and computes hexadecimal from the digest bytes.

name: ^jetstreamManagers\.(get|set|delete)$
reason: JavaScript WeakMap methods supply cache reads and writes; the twin checks cache keys, concurrent manager creation and promise insertion.

name: ^connection\.jetstreamManager$
reason: The NATS SDK supplies a manager with its documented checkAPI option; the twin checks that probe suppression and cache behavior.

name: Promise
reason: A promise is an identity token for an in-flight SDK request; its fulfilled value comes only from the checked effect outcome.

name: WeakMap
reason: JavaScript owns weak-reference storage; twins check method names and keys rather than inspect its storage.

name: ^requireSecretsEnv$
reason: Operator configuration supplies the account encryption secrets; the twin checks the exact environment variable name.

name: ^new AccountCipher$
reason: The account encryption implementation owns authenticated encryption and key unwrapping; the twin checks tenant, key list, secrets and primitive wiring.

name: AccountCipher
reason: The envelope implementation verifies tenant-scoped encryption; the wrapper twin checks construction and decrypt arguments and rejection of empty results.

name: ^new Date$
reason: The system clock supplies the current epoch milliseconds; explicit UTC ISO timestamps are computed from the input by the twin.

name: ^acceptIngress$
reason: Ingress admission is decided by the Convex mutation; the twin checks the whole candidate and only branches on the returned outcome and owner generation.

name: ^collectSecretValues$
reason: The secret collector walks the configuration it is given; the twin checks exactly which configuration values are passed in.

name: ^(consumer\.consume|js\.consumers\.get|options\.connection\.jetstream)$
reason: The NATS client builds consumers; the twin checks the stream name, subject filter and start policy.

name: ^jsm\.streams\.(info|getMessage)$
reason: The NATS server reports stream state; the twin checks the subject filter and computes the snapshot from the answer.

name: ^createAgentHookDispatcher$
reason: The hook dispatcher is built from checked account and agent config and is passed through unread.

name: ^crons\.(completeRun|failRun)$
reason: The storage adapter writes the cron run row; the twin checks ids and the settled result.

name: ^getStorage\(\)( )?\.crons\.(remove|createRun)$
reason: The storage adapter writes cron rows; the twin checks account, cron and run identifiers.

name: ^(getStorage\(\)|storage)\.agents\.getById$
reason: The storage adapter reads the agent row by checked account and agent id; absence is handled by the twin.

name: ^getStorage\(\)\.agentDeployments\.getByAgentId$
reason: The storage adapter reads the deployment row by checked ids; the twin copies only its stage fields.

name: ^storage\.channelRecords\.getById$
reason: The storage adapter reads the channel record by checked ids; the twin evaluates its status and binding.

name: ^getStorage\(\)\.connections\.(load|saveRefreshed)$
reason: The storage adapter owns the compare-and-swap on the connection row; the twin checks arguments and handles both answers.

name: ^(dispatchNext|full)$
reason: A caller-supplied callback; the twin checks when it runs and handles its answer.

name: ^finishedBefore$
reason: The window callback comes from lostResultWindows; the twin checks the handback it is asked about.

name: ^getFunctionName$
reason: The Convex SDK reads a function reference name; the twin passes it unchanged to makeFunctionReference.

name: ^makeFunctionReference$
reason: The Convex SDK builds a reference from a checked name.

name: ^getConvexClient\(\)\.(query|mutation)$
reason: The Convex client performs the admin call; the twin checks the reference, arguments and options.

name: ^listOwedAsyncToolResults$
reason: Convex pages the owed result rows; the twin checks each filter and follows the returned cursor.

name: ^markAsyncToolHandback$
reason: Convex records the hand-back; the twin checks the result id and the stored state.

name: ^new Session$
reason: The Session constructor stores the options it is given; the twin checks every option.

name: ^options\.(consumeStream|onQuestionsPending)$
reason: A callback supplied by the caller; the twin checks its arguments and timing.

name: ^queuePlace\.run$
reason: AsyncLocalStorage runs the callback with the held place; the twin checks the place and returns the callback answer.

name: ^(redactWithRunSecrets|runSecretValues)$
reason: The log redactor scrubs known secret strings; the twin checks what is scrubbed and with which secrets.

name: ^toErrorMessage$
reason: Formats a caught value for a message; the twin checks the error it is given.

name: ^runAgentLoop$
reason: The model loop is the boundary of this function; the twin checks session, turn, config, callbacks and options.

name: ^session\.(assertCurrentOwner|createTurnContext|releaseConversationLease|settleIngress)$
reason: Session methods own the durable lease and turn state; the twin checks arguments, order and handles both answers.

name: ^stream\.(didFail|failureText|questionSummaries|traceId|yielded)$
reason: Stream accessors expose the finished model pass; the twin decides what happens next from their answers.

name: ReadableStreamDefaultController
reason: The platform owns the stream controller; the twin checks the enqueued bytes and the close.

name: ReadableStream
reason: The platform owns the stream object; the twin checks its underlying source.

name: Session
reason: The session is an identity handle here; twins read only its recorded scalar fields and check its method calls.

name: SubagentCoordinator
reason: The coordinator is an identity handle here; twins check the methods called on it.

name: apps/core/src/harness/ingress.ts#trackOwner
reason: Only adds to the in-memory lease map, which recordings do not capture, so no twin can observe it; callers are checked to call it with the right lease.

name: apps/core/src/harness/ingress.ts#forgetOwner
reason: Only removes from the in-memory lease map, which recordings do not capture; callers are checked to call it with the right lease.

name: ^(new ReadableStream|controller\.(enqueue|close))$
reason: The platform owns the response stream; the twin checks the underlying source, the exact enqueued bytes and the close.

name: ^getStorage\(\)\.crons\.(failRun|markFailed)$
reason: The storage adapter writes the cron failure; the twin checks account, cron and run identifiers and the message.
